definitions.explanation: A journey to a distant place for a specific purpose, historically for military campaigns or exploration.
Traveling to another location to compete in sports, attend a concert, or participate in an event. Very common in modern usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧{遠征|えんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I took part in an Antarctic expedition.

examples.japanese: モンゴル⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遠征|えんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: The Mongol Empire repeatedly launched campaigns to the west.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧エベレスト{遠征|えんせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰還|きかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mountaineering team returned safely from their Everest expedition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧{遠征|えんせい}だ。
examples.english: Next week is the away trip to Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遠征|えんせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to Tokyo for a concert trip.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遠征|えんせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: We've been losing in away games this season.

notes:
Originally a military and exploration term, now very commonly used in sports and fan culture. Sports fans traveling to see their team play away, or music fans traveling to distant concerts, frequently call such trips {遠征|えんせい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠征|えんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go on an expedition; to travel for an away game
- {遠征|えんせい}⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧: away game
- {遠征|えんせい}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: expedition/travel expenses
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{遠征|えんせい}: overseas expedition/trip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧: exploration — focuses on discovery of unknown places
- ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧: business trip — specifically for work purposes
- ⟦{冒険|ぼうけん}→冒険：03629_bouken⟧: adventure — emphasizes danger and excitement
